data.name: Capybara Dungeon
data.detailed_description:
Capybara Dungeon

Capybara Dungeon is a first-person cooperative multiplayer game where you and your friends control capybara explorers venturing into dangerous dungeons and hostile environments, filled with strange creatures, deadly traps, and situations that blend horror, tension, and absolute chaos.

Explore, survive, and try to make it back alive — if panic doesn’t take over first.

🛋️ Local Multiplayer: couch chaos

Play Capybara Dungeon in local split-screen multiplayer and face the chaos side by side.
No distance, no delay — just real screams, instant laughter, and terrible last-second decisions.

Sharing the screen means sharing the panic:
one player spots the danger first, another presses the wrong button, and someone always completely loses it.

Playing solo is hard.
Playing with friends on the same couch… is confusing, loud, and absurdly fun.

Cooperation is essential

Play online with up to 4 players and rely on communication to survive.
Warnings, screams, and last-second calls are all part of the experience.
Alone is hard. Together, it’s terrifying… and much more fun.

Unpredictable dungeons

Each run takes you into dark, hostile dungeons with changing rooms, corridors, and events.
Never trust your memory — what was safe before might be deadly now.

Creatures that hunt in the dark

Something is watching.
Some creatures react to noise, others appear when you least expect it.
Sometimes, staying silent is the only way to survive — and avoid getting caught in a dark corner.

 Tools, loot, and bad decisions

Use flashlights, strange equipment, and items found inside the dungeon to explore and complete objectives.
But be careful: carrying too much loot can slow the team down — and turn into a death sentence.

Horror with humor

Capybaras slip, open the wrong doors, pull the wrong levers, and panic together.
In Capybara Dungeon, the fear is real — but the absurd situations create unforgettable moments… or permanent hair loss.

 Every run tells a story

Narrow escapes, questionable sacrifices, and memorable mistakes are all part of the game — or the complete lack of brain cells in your friends.
Surviving is already a victory. Bringing everyone back alive is a miracle.

Key Features

🐾 Online cooperative multiplayer (1–4 players)
🎮 First-person gameplay
🕳️ Dynamic and unpredictable dungeons
👹 Scary creatures with varied behaviors
🎙️ Voice communication is essential

🔁 High replayability

Enter the dungeon.
Trust your friends.
And remember: not every capybara comes back alive.
